ops.title: Side note: Templates vs System Prompts

ops.markdown:
Prompt templates differ from system prompts in the sense that they are used for **specific use cases under the broader application**.

e.g. query answer for a specific use case.

The system prompt sets the application; the template serves one job inside it.
